passages.text: This is the account of Aaron and Moses at the time the LORD spoke with Moses on Mount Sinai.
passages.sermon: Aaron and Moses were brothers.\r\nThe LORD spoke with Moses on Mount Sinai.\r\nThis is the account of Aaron and Moses at that time.
passages.original: וְאֵ֛לֶּה תּוֹלְדֹ֥ת אַהֲרֹ֖ן וּמֹשֶׁ֑ה בְּי֗וֹם דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּהַ֥ר סִינָֽי׃

passages.text: These are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab the firstborn, then Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
passages.sermon:
Aaron was the first high priest of Israel.
Aaron had four sons.
Their names were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
Nadab was the oldest son.
Abihu was the second son.
Eleazar was the third son.
Ithamar was the fourth son.
passages.original: וְאֵ֛לֶּה שְׁמ֥וֹת בְּֽנֵי־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן הַבְּכ֣וֹר׀ נָדָ֑ב וַאֲבִיה֕וּא אֶלְעָזָ֖ר וְאִיתָמָֽר׃

passages.text: These were Aaron’s sons, the anointed priests, who were ordained to serve as priests.
passages.sermon:
Aaron had sons.
These sons became priests.
People anointed these sons.
They ordained these sons to serve as priests.
passages.original: אֵ֗לֶּה שְׁמוֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֔ן הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים הַמְּשֻׁחִ֑ים אֲשֶׁר־ מִלֵּ֥א יָדָ֖ם לְכַהֵֽן׃

passages.text: Nadab and Abihu, however, died in the presence of the LORD when they offered unauthorized fire before the LORD in the Wilderness of Sinai. And since they had no sons, only Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests during the lifetime of their father Aaron.
passages.sermon:
Nadab and Abihu were sons of Aaron.
Nadab and Abihu died before the LORD.
They died when they offered unauthorized fire before the LORD.
This happened in the Wilderness of Sinai.
Nadab and Abihu had no sons.
Eleazar and Ithamar were also sons of Aaron.
Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.
They served as priests while their father Aaron was alive.
passages.original: וַיָּ֣מָת נָדָ֣ב וַאֲבִיה֣וּא לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֡ה בְּֽהַקְרִבָם֩ אֵ֨שׁ זָרָ֜ה לִפְנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ בְּמִדְבַּ֣ר סִינַ֔י וּבָנִ֖ים לֹא־ הָי֣וּ לָהֶ֑ם וַיְכַהֵ֤ן אֶלְעָזָר֙ וְאִ֣יתָמָ֔ר עַל־ פְּנֵ֖י אַהֲרֹ֥ן אֲבִיהֶֽם׃פ

passages.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Bring the tribe of Levi and present them to Aaron the priest to assist him.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses a command.
The LORD told Moses to bring the tribe of Levi.
The tribe of Levi are the descendants of Levi.
Moses must present the tribe of Levi to Aaron.
Aaron is the priest.
The Levites must assist Aaron.
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃ הַקְרֵב֙ אֶת־ מַטֵּ֣ה לֵוִ֔י וְֽהַעֲמַדְתָּ֣ אֹת֔וֹ לִפְנֵ֖י אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֑ן וְשֵׁרְת֖וּ אֹתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: They are to perform duties for him and for the whole congregation before the Tent of Meeting, attending to the service of the tabernacle.
passages.sermon:
The Levites must serve Aaron the priest.
The Levites must help the whole congregation of Israel.
They must do this work in front of the Tent of Meeting.
They must perform the service of the tabernacle.
passages.original: וְשָׁמְר֣וּ אֶת־ מִשְׁמַרְתּ֗וֹ וְאֶת־ מִשְׁמֶ֙רֶת֙ כָּל־ הָ֣עֵדָ֔ה לִפְנֵ֖י אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד לַעֲבֹ֖ד אֶת־ עֲבֹדַ֥ת הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃

passages.text: They shall take care of all the furnishings of the Tent of Meeting and fulfill obligations for the Israelites by attending to the service of the tabernacle.
passages.sermon:
The Levites are a tribe in Israel.
God chose the Levites to serve Him.
The Levites must take care of all the furnishings in the Tent of Meeting.
The Tent of Meeting is the place where Israel meets with God.
The Levites must also fulfill the duties required of the Israelites.
They do this by serving in the tabernacle.
The tabernacle is the holy place where God’s presence dwells.
The Levites serve God and the people by doing this work.
passages.original: וְשָׁמְר֗וּ אֶֽת־ כָּל־ כְּלֵי֙ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וְאֶת־ מִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לַעֲבֹ֖ד אֶת־ עֲבֹדַ֥ת הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃

passages.text: Assign the Levites to Aaron and his sons; they have been given exclusively to him from among the Israelites.
passages.sermon:
The Levites are a tribe in Israel.
God chose the Levites from among all the Israelites.
God gave the Levites to Aaron and his sons.
Aaron and his sons are priests.
The Levites belong only to Aaron and his sons.
The Levites serve Aaron and his sons.
The Levites do not serve anyone else among the Israelites.
passages.original: וְנָתַתָּה֙ אֶת־ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן וּלְבָנָ֑יו נְתוּנִ֨ם נְתוּנִ֥ם הֵ֙מָּה֙ ל֔וֹ מֵאֵ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: So you shall appoint Aaron and his sons to carry out the duties of the priesthood; but any outsider who approaches the tabernacle must be put to death.”
passages.sermon:
Aaron was the high priest of Israel.
Aaron had sons who served as priests.
You must appoint Aaron and his sons to serve as priests.
They must guard and perform all priestly duties.
Only Aaron and his sons may serve as priests.
Any outsider who comes near the priestly service must be put to death.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ אַהֲרֹ֤ן וְאֶת־ בָּנָיו֙ תִּפְקֹ֔ד וְשָׁמְר֖וּ אֶת־ כְּהֻנָּתָ֑ם וְהַזָּ֥ר הַקָּרֵ֖ב יוּמָֽת׃פ

passages.text: Again the LORD spoke to Moses, saying, “Behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel in place of every firstborn Israelite from the womb. The Levites belong to Me, for all the firstborn are Mine. On the day I struck down every firstborn in the land of Egypt, I consecrated to Myself all the firstborn in Israel, both man and beast. They are Mine; I am the LORD.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD said these words to Moses.
The LORD said, “I have taken the Levites from among the Israelites.
I took the Levites instead of every firstborn who opens the womb among the Israelites.
The Levites belong to Me.
All the firstborn belong to Me.
On the day I struck down every firstborn in the land of Egypt, I set apart for Myself all the firstborn in Israel.
I set apart both man and animal.
They belong to Me.
I am the LORD.”
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃ וַאֲנִ֞י הִנֵּ֧ה לָקַ֣חְתִּי אֶת־ הַלְוִיִּ֗ם מִתּוֹךְ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל תַּ֧חַת כָּל־ בְּכ֛וֹר פֶּ֥טֶר רֶ֖חֶם מִבְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְהָ֥יוּ לִ֖י הַלְוִיִּֽם׃ כִּ֣י לִי֮ כָּל־ בְּכוֹר֒ בְּיוֹם֩ הַכֹּתִ֨י כָל־ בְּכ֜וֹר בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֗יִם הִקְדַּ֨שְׁתִּי לִ֤י כָל־ בְּכוֹר֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מֵאָדָ֖ם עַד־ בְּהֵמָ֑ה לִ֥י יִהְי֖וּ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס

passages.text: Then the LORD spoke to Moses in the Wilderness of Sinai, saying, “Number the Levites by their families and clans. You are to count every male a month old or more.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
They were in the Wilderness of Sinai.
The LORD gave Moses a command.
The LORD said, "Count the Levites."
The Levites are a tribe of Israel.
Count them by their families.
Count them by their clans.
Count every male Levite.
Count each one who is one month old or older.
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה בְּמִדְבַּ֥ר סִינַ֖י לֵאמֹֽר׃ פְּקֹד֙ אֶת־ בְּנֵ֣י לֵוִ֔י לְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹתָ֖ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם כָּל־ זָכָ֛ר מִבֶּן־ חֹ֥דֶשׁ וָמַ֖עְלָה תִּפְקְדֵֽם׃

passages.text: So Moses numbered them according to the word of the LORD, as he had been commanded.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses a command.
Moses obeyed the LORD.
Moses counted the Levites.
Moses counted them as the LORD commanded.
passages.original: וַיִּפְקֹ֥ד אֹתָ֛ם מֹשֶׁ֖ה עַל־ פִּ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר צֻוָּֽה׃

passages.text: These were the sons of Levi by name: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
passages.sermon: Levi was a man from the tribe of Israel.\r\nLevi had three sons.\r\nTheir names were Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
passages.original: וַיִּֽהְיוּ־ אֵ֥לֶּה בְנֵֽי־ לֵוִ֖י בִּשְׁמֹתָ֑ם גֵּרְשׁ֕וֹן וּקְהָ֖ת וּמְרָרִֽי׃

passages.text: These were the names of the sons of Gershon by their clans: Libni and Shimei.
passages.sermon:
Gershon was a son of Levi.
Gershon had sons.
Their names were Libni and Shimei.
Each son became the head of a clan.
These clans were called by their names: the Libnite clan and the Shimeite clan.
passages.original: וְאֵ֛לֶּה שְׁמ֥וֹת בְּֽנֵי־ גֵרְשׁ֖וֹן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם לִבְנִ֖י וְשִׁמְעִֽי׃

passages.text: The sons of Kohath by their clans were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
passages.sermon:
Kohath was a son of Levi.
Kohath had four sons.
Their names were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
Each son became the ancestor of a clan.
These clans came from Kohath.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֥י קְהָ֖ת לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם עַמְרָ֣ם וְיִצְהָ֔ר חֶבְר֖וֹן וְעֻזִּיאֵֽל׃

passages.text: And the sons of Merari by their clans were Mahli and Mushi. These were the clans of the Levites, according to their families.
passages.sermon:
Merari was a son of Levi.
Merari had two sons.
Their names were Mahli and Mushi.
Mahli and Mushi each became the founders of clans.
These clans belonged to the Levites.
Each clan traced its family through its ancestor.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֧י מְרָרִ֛י לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם מַחְלִ֣י וּמוּשִׁ֑י אֵ֥לֶּה הֵ֛ם מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת הַלֵּוִ֖י לְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: From Gershon came the Libnite clan and the Shimeite clan; these were the Gershonite clans.
passages.sermon:
Gershon was a son of Levi.
Gershon had descendants.
Two clans came from Gershon.
The first clan was the Libnite clan.
The second clan was the Shimeite clan.
These two clans were called the Gershonite clans.
passages.original: לְגֵ֣רְשׁ֔וֹן מִשְׁפַּ֙חַת֙ הַלִּבְנִ֔י וּמִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַשִּׁמְעִ֑י אֵ֣לֶּה הֵ֔ם מִשְׁפְּחֹ֖ת הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּֽי׃

passages.text: The number of all the males a month old or more was 7,500.
passages.sermon:
The Gershonite clans belonged to the tribe of Levi.
The Gershonites had a census.
They counted all the males in their clans.
They counted only those who were one month old or older.
The total number of these males was 7,500.
passages.original: פְּקֻדֵיהֶם֙ בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר כָּל־ זָכָ֔ר מִבֶּן־ חֹ֖דֶשׁ וָמָ֑עְלָה פְּקֻ֣דֵיהֶ֔ם שִׁבְעַ֥ת אֲלָפִ֖ים וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃

passages.text: The Gershonite clans were to camp on the west, behind the tabernacle, and the leader of the families of the Gershonites was Eliasaph son of Lael.
passages.sermon:
The Gershonite clans came from Gershon.
The Gershonite clans camped on the west side.
They camped behind the tabernacle.
Eliasaph was their leader.
Eliasaph was the son of Lael.
Eliasaph led the families of the Gershonites.
passages.original: מִשְׁפְּחֹ֖ת הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֑י אַחֲרֵ֧י הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ן יַחֲנ֖וּ יָֽמָּה׃ וּנְשִׂ֥יא בֵֽית־ אָ֖ב לַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֑י אֶלְיָסָ֖ף בֶּן־ לָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: The duties of the Gershonites at the Tent of Meeting were the tabernacle and tent, its covering, the curtain for the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, the curtains of the courtyard, the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard that surrounds the tabernacle and altar, and the cords—all the service for these items.
passages.sermon:
The Gershonites were a clan of Levites.
God gave the Gershonites special duties at the Tent of Meeting.
They cared for the tabernacle and the tent.
They took care of the tent’s covering.
They managed the curtain at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
They were responsible for the curtains of the courtyard.
They looked after the curtain at the entrance to the courtyard.
This courtyard surrounded the tabernacle and the altar.
The Gershonites also cared for the cords used for these things.
They performed all the service for these items.
passages.original: וּמִשְׁמֶ֤רֶת בְּנֵֽי־ גֵרְשׁוֹן֙ בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן וְהָאֹ֑הֶל מִכְסֵ֕הוּ וּמָסַ֕ךְ פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃ וְקַלְעֵ֣י הֶֽחָצֵ֗ר וְאֶת־ מָסַךְ֙ פֶּ֣תַח הֶֽחָצֵ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֧ר עַל־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ן וְעַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִ֑יב וְאֵת֙ מֵֽיתָרָ֔יו לְכֹ֖ל עֲבֹדָתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: From Kohath came the clans of the Amramites, the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites; these were the clans of the Kohathites.
passages.sermon:
Kohath was a son of Levi.
Kohath had descendants.
The descendants of Kohath formed clans.
The clans from Kohath were the Amramites, the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites.
These clans were called the Kohathite clans.
passages.original: וְלִקְהָ֗ת מִשְׁפַּ֤חַת הַֽעַמְרָמִי֙ וּמִשְׁפַּ֣חַת הַיִּצְהָרִ֔י וּמִשְׁפַּ֙חַת֙ הַֽחֶבְרֹנִ֔י וּמִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הָֽעָזִּיאֵלִ֑י אֵ֥לֶּה הֵ֖ם מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת הַקְּהָתִֽי׃

passages.text: The number of all the males a month old or more was 8,600. They were responsible for the duties of the sanctuary.
passages.sermon:
The Kohathite clans belonged to the tribe of Levi.
All their males who were one month old or older were counted.
The total number was 8,600.
These men had a special duty.
They were responsible for the work of the sanctuary.
passages.original: בְּמִסְפַּר֙ כָּל־ זָכָ֔ר מִבֶּן־ חֹ֖דֶשׁ וָמָ֑עְלָה שְׁמֹנַ֤ת אֲלָפִים֙ וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מֵא֔וֹת שֹׁמְרֵ֖י מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃

passages.text: The clans of the Kohathites were to camp on the south side of the tabernacle, and the leader of the families of the Kohathites was Elizaphan son of Uzziel.
passages.sermon:
The Kohathites were a group of Levites.
The Kohathite clans camped on the south side of the tabernacle.
Elizaphan was their leader.
Elizaphan was the son of Uzziel.
passages.original: מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת בְּנֵי־ קְהָ֖ת יַחֲנ֑וּ עַ֛ל יֶ֥רֶךְ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן תֵּימָֽנָה׃ וּנְשִׂ֥יא בֵֽית־ אָ֖ב לְמִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת הַקְּהָתִ֑י אֶלִיצָפָ֖ן בֶּן־ עֻזִּיאֵֽל׃

passages.text: Their duties were the ark, the table, the lampstand, the altars, the articles of the sanctuary used with them, and the curtain—all the service for these items.
passages.sermon:
The Kohathites were Levites.
They had special duties in the sanctuary.
They cared for the ark.
They cared for the table.
They cared for the lampstand.
They cared for the altars.
They cared for the holy articles used with these items.
They cared for the curtain.
They performed all the service for these things.
passages.original: וּמִשְׁמַרְתָּ֗ם הָאָרֹ֤ן וְהַשֻּׁלְחָן֙ וְהַמְּנֹרָ֣ה וְהַֽמִּזְבְּחֹ֔ת וּכְלֵ֣י הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְשָׁרְת֖וּ בָּהֶ֑ם וְהַ֨מָּסָ֔ךְ וְכֹ֖ל עֲבֹדָתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: The chief of the leaders of the Levites was Eleazar son of Aaron the priest; he oversaw those responsible for the duties of the sanctuary.
passages.sermon:
Eleazar was the son of Aaron.
Aaron was the priest.
Eleazar was the chief leader of the Levites.
Eleazar oversaw the people who cared for the sanctuary.
These people were responsible for the duties of the sanctuary.
passages.original: וּנְשִׂיא֙ נְשִׂיאֵ֣י הַלֵּוִ֔י אֶלְעָזָ֖ר בֶּן־ אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֑ן פְּקֻדַּ֕ת שֹׁמְרֵ֖י מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃

passages.text: From Merari came the clans of the Mahlites and Mushites; these were the Merarite clans.
passages.sermon:
Merari was a Levite.
Merari had descendants.
Two clans came from Merari.
The first clan was the Mahlites.
The second clan was the Mushites.
These two clans were called the Merarite clans.
passages.original: לִמְרָרִ֕י מִשְׁפַּ֙חַת֙ הַמַּחְלִ֔י וּמִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַמּוּשִׁ֑י אֵ֥לֶּה הֵ֖ם מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת מְרָרִֽי׃

passages.text: The number of all the males a month old or more was 6,200.
passages.sermon:
The passage describes the Merarite clans.
The Merarite clans belonged to the tribe of Levi.
The passage counts all their males.
It counts every male who was one month old or older.
The total number was 6,200.
passages.original: וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם֙ בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר כָּל־ זָכָ֔ר מִבֶּן־ חֹ֖דֶשׁ וָמָ֑עְלָה שֵׁ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים וּמָאתָֽיִם׃

passages.text: The leader of the families of the Merarites was Zuriel son of Abihail; they were to camp on the north side of the tabernacle.
passages.sermon:
The Merarites were a group of Levites.
Zuriel was their leader.
Zuriel was the son of Abihail.
The Merarites camped on the north side of the tabernacle.
passages.original: וּנְשִׂ֤יא בֵֽית־ אָב֙ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת מְרָרִ֔י צוּרִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ אֲבִיחָ֑יִל עַ֣ל יֶ֧רֶךְ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ן יַחֲנ֖וּ צָפֹֽנָה׃

passages.text: The duties assigned to the sons of Merari were the tabernacle’s frames, crossbars, posts, bases, and all its equipment—all the service for these items, as well as the posts of the surrounding courtyard with their bases, tent pegs, and ropes.
passages.sermon:
The sons of Merari were Levites.
God gave them special duties.
They cared for the frames of the tabernacle.
They cared for the crossbars of the tabernacle.
They cared for the posts of the tabernacle.
They cared for the bases of the tabernacle.
They cared for all the equipment of the tabernacle.
They did all the work for these items.
They also cared for the posts around the courtyard.
They cared for the bases of the courtyard posts.
They cared for the tent pegs.
They cared for the ropes.
passages.original: וּפְקֻדַּ֣ת מִשְׁמֶרֶת֮ בְּנֵ֣י מְרָרִי֒ קַרְשֵׁי֙ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן וּבְרִיחָ֖יו וְעַמֻּדָ֣יו וַאֲדָנָ֑יו וְכָל־ כֵּלָ֔יו וְכֹ֖ל עֲבֹדָתֽוֹ׃ וְעַמֻּדֵ֧י הֶחָצֵ֛ר סָבִ֖יב וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֑ם וִיתֵדֹתָ֖ם וּמֵֽיתְרֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Moses, Aaron, and Aaron’s sons were to camp to the east of the tabernacle, toward the sunrise, before the Tent of Meeting. They were to perform the duties of the sanctuary as a service on behalf of the Israelites; but any outsider who approached the sanctuary was to be put to death.
passages.sermon:
Moses, Aaron, and Aaron’s sons were leaders of Israel.
They camped on the east side of the tabernacle.
They camped in front of the Tent of Meeting.
They stayed where the sun rises.
They guarded the sanctuary.
They served on behalf of the Israelites.
They performed all the duties of the sanctuary.
No outsider could approach the sanctuary.
If any outsider came near, he would be put to death.
passages.original: וְהַחֹנִ֣ים לִפְנֵ֣י הַמִּשְׁכָּ֡ן קֵ֣דְמָה לִפְנֵי֩ אֹֽהֶל־ מוֹעֵ֨ד׀ מִזְרָ֜חָה מֹשֶׁ֣ה׀ וְאַהֲרֹ֣ן וּבָנָ֗יו שֹֽׁמְרִים֙ מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת הַמִּקְדָּ֔שׁ לְמִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְהַזָּ֥ר הַקָּרֵ֖ב יוּמָֽת׃

passages.text: The total number of Levites that Moses and Aaron counted by their clans at the LORD’s command, including all the males a month old or more, was 22,000.
passages.sermon:
Moses and Aaron counted the Levites.
They did this by the command of the LORD.
They counted them by their clans.
They counted every male Levite who was one month old or older.
The total number was 22,000.
passages.original: כָּל־ פְּקוּדֵ֨י הַלְוִיִּ֜ם אֲשֶׁר֩ פָּקַ֨ד מֹשֶׁ֧ה וְׄאַׄהֲׄרֹ֛ׄןׄ עַל־ פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם כָּל־ זָכָר֙ מִבֶּן־ חֹ֣דֶשׁ וָמַ֔עְלָה שְׁנַ֥יִם וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים אָֽלֶף׃ס

passages.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Number every firstborn male of the Israelites a month old or more, and list their names.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses a command.
The LORD told Moses to count every firstborn male among the Israelites.
Each firstborn male must be at least one month old.
Moses must write down the names of all these firstborn males.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֗ה פְּקֹ֨ד כָּל־ בְּכֹ֤ר זָכָר֙ לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִבֶּן־ חֹ֖דֶשׁ וָמָ֑עְלָה וְשָׂ֕א אֵ֖ת מִסְפַּ֥ר שְׁמֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: You are to take the Levites for Me—I am the LORD—in place of all the firstborn of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites in place of all the firstborn of the livestock of the Israelites.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave a command.
The LORD said, “I am the LORD.”
Take the Levites for Me.
Take them instead of all the firstborn sons of Israel.
Take the Levites’ livestock for Me.
Take their livestock instead of all the firstborn livestock of the Israelites.
passages.original: וְלָקַחְתָּ֨ אֶת־ הַלְוִיִּ֥ם לִי֙ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה תַּ֥חַת כָּל־ בְּכֹ֖ר בִּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְאֵת֙ בֶּהֱמַ֣ת הַלְוִיִּ֔ם תַּ֣חַת כָּל־ בְּכ֔וֹר בְּבֶהֱמַ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: So Moses numbered all the firstborn of the Israelites, as the LORD had commanded him.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of the Israelites.
The LORD gave Moses a command.
The LORD told Moses to count all the firstborn sons of the Israelites.
Moses obeyed the LORD.
Moses counted every firstborn among the Israelites.
passages.original: וַיִּפְקֹ֣ד מֹשֶׁ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֹת֑וֹ אֶֽת־ כָּל־ בְּכֹ֖ר בִּבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: The total number of the firstborn males a month old or more, listed by name, was 22,273.
passages.sermon:
Moses counted the firstborn males of Israel.
He listed each one by name.
He included only those who were at least one month old.
The total number was 22,273.
passages.original: וַיְהִי֩ כָל־ בְּכ֨וֹר זָכָ֜ר בְּמִסְפַּ֥ר שֵׁמ֛וֹת מִבֶּן־ חֹ֥דֶשׁ וָמַ֖עְלָה לִפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם שְׁנַ֤יִם וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה וְשִׁבְעִ֖ים וּמָאתָֽיִם׃פ

passages.text: Again the LORD spoke to Moses, saying, “Take the Levites in place of all the firstborn of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites in place of their livestock. The Levites belong to Me; I am the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses a command.
The LORD said, “Take the Levites.
Take the Levites instead of every firstborn among the Israelites.
Take the livestock of the Levites instead of the livestock of the Israelites.
The Levites will belong to Me.
I am the LORD.”
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃ קַ֣ח אֶת־ הַלְוִיִּ֗ם תַּ֤חַת כָּל־ בְּכוֹר֙ בִּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאֶת־ בֶּהֱמַ֥ת הַלְוִיִּ֖ם תַּ֣חַת בְּהֶמְתָּ֑ם וְהָיוּ־ לִ֥י הַלְוִיִּ֖ם אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: To redeem the 273 firstborn Israelites who outnumber the Levites, you are to collect five shekels for each one, according to the sanctuary shekel of twenty gerahs.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God gave Moses instructions for the Israelites.
There were 273 firstborn Israelite males who outnumbered the Levites.
These 273 firstborn needed to be redeemed.
Moses must collect money for their redemption.
Moses must take five shekels for each person.
Moses must use the sanctuary shekel as the standard.
One sanctuary shekel equals twenty gerahs.
passages.original: וְאֵת֙ פְּדוּיֵ֣י הַשְּׁלֹשָׁ֔ה וְהַשִּׁבְעִ֖ים וְהַמָּאתָ֑יִם הָעֹֽדְפִים֙ עַל־ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם מִבְּכ֖וֹר בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ וְלָקַחְתָּ֗ חֲמֵ֧שֶׁת חֲמֵ֛שֶׁת שְׁקָלִ֖ים לַגֻּלְגֹּ֑לֶת בְּשֶׁ֤קֶל הַקֹּ֙דֶשׁ֙ תִּקָּ֔ח עֶשְׂרִ֥ים גֵּרָ֖ה הַשָּֽׁקֶל׃

passages.text: Give the money to Aaron and his sons as the redemption price for the excess among the Israelites.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God told Moses to collect money from the Israelites.
Some firstborn Israelites outnumbered the Levites.
These extra firstborn needed to be redeemed.
Moses had to collect money for each extra firstborn.
Moses had to give this money to Aaron and his sons.
This money was the redemption price for the extra firstborn Israelites.
passages.original: וְנָתַתָּ֣ה הַכֶּ֔סֶף לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן וּלְבָנָ֑יו פְּדוּיֵ֕י הָעֹדְפִ֖ים בָּהֶֽם׃

passages.text: So Moses collected the redemption money from those in excess of the number redeemed by the Levites.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of the Israelites.
The Levites were a special tribe set apart for God.
There were more firstborn Israelites than Levites.
Some firstborn Israelites did not have a Levite to take their place.
Moses collected redemption money from these extra firstborn Israelites.
These were the ones who were more than the number of Levites.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֣ח מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֵ֖ת כֶּ֣סֶף הַפִּדְי֑וֹם מֵאֵת֙ הָעֹ֣דְפִ֔ים עַ֖ל פְּדוּיֵ֥י הַלְוִיִּֽם׃

passages.text: He collected the money from the firstborn of the Israelites: 1,365 shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel.
passages.sermon: Moses collected money from the firstborn sons of the Israelites.\r\nHe took 1,365 shekels.\r\nHe used the sanctuary shekel as the standard.
passages.original: מֵאֵ֗ת בְּכ֛וֹר בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לָקַ֣ח אֶת־ הַכָּ֑סֶף חֲמִשָּׁ֨ה וְשִׁשִּׁ֜ים וּשְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֛וֹת וָאֶ֖לֶף בְּשֶׁ֥קֶל הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃

passages.text: And Moses gave the redemption money to Aaron and his sons in obedience to the word of the LORD, just as the LORD had commanded him.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of the Israelites.
The LORD gave Moses commands.
Moses received redemption money from the Israelites.
Aaron was the high priest.
Aaron’s sons served as priests.
Moses gave the redemption money to Aaron and his sons.
Moses acted according to the word of the LORD.
The LORD had commanded Moses to do this.
passages.original: וַיִּתֵּ֨ן מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶת־ כֶּ֧סֶף הַפְּדֻיִ֛ם לְאַהֲרֹ֥ן וּלְבָנָ֖יו עַל־ פִּ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃פ
